en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a European market square with cobblestone streets and historic townhouses. In the center foreground, the year "1902" and a coat of arms are drawn on the pavement. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand near gas‑style street lamps. On the right, a large building carries the sign "HOTEL GOLDENER LÖWE," and next to it another building reads "Hotel Deutsches Haus." The caption at the top in red letters says "Waldenburg. Markt." indicating the town's market square.
